specs.name: power
specs.source_sentence: Introduced in 2003, it featured redesigned bumpers and was fitted with a higher-output version of the 1.5-liter engine, producing 85 kW; 113 hp (115 PS).

specs.name: torque
specs.source_sentence: The production model of Swift Sport is powered by a revised 1.6-liter four-cylinder (M16A) from previous generation Swift Sport's engine and producing 100 kW; 134 bhp (136 PS) and 160 N⋅m (118 lb⋅ft).

specs.name: engine_litre
specs.source_sentence: Vehicles fitted with the 1.3-liter engine were designated HT51S, with the 1.5-liter version assigned HT81S.

specs.name: mileage
specs.source_sentence: With the Dualjet technology and the ENE-CHARGE, fuel economy is now up to 26.4 km/L, calculated based on JC08 mode.
